primary_question: Does a BID-vs-ELAP 5-mer sequence fingerprint learned in one cell line transfer to the other after exact genomic-locus leakage removal?
primary_score: Jeffreys-smoothed 5-mer log relative-frequency ratio; alpha=0.5; 256-motif universe
null_test: permute learned motif-score assignments across motif identities before application to held-out cell
secondary_calibration_decomposition: training-cell motif log-ratio ~ fixed synthetic calibration contrast, weighted by training motif counts; test calibration component and residual fingerprint on held-out cell
interpretation_boundary: Cross-cell transfer supports a stable technology-associated sequence fingerprint, not proof that the fingerprint is entirely assay-caused. Stable biological sequence preferences may contribute and are addressed in subsequent biological/annotation controls.
